statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal palpitations
The patient has recent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a diagnosis of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is ordered
The service is to evaluate for atrial fibrillation burden and potential embolic sources
The denial reason is CO-22 (care may be covered by another payer according to coordination of benefits rules)
